description:
One legal entity by ЄДРПОУ code or `record`, with its people.

`people`: founders, beneficial owners, signers and board members; the head is
the latest appointment. `company` adds termination, bankruptcy, succession,
branches and tax registration.

`history`: changes per weekly release since tracking began; `on_date`: people
then. Earlier history: paid НАІС extract only.

A code shared by several subjects returns the live one, the rest in
`other_subjects`.

No address or КВЕД codes upstream.

on_date.description: Add people as of this date.

record.description: ЄДР subject id, from a hit.
